label: Terrazzo · multicolour (white matrix, multicolour confetti chips)

source.selection_reason: Owner-curated white terrazzo product tile (DNA Terrazzo White Colours 32x37) with multicoloured confetti chips (blue, ochre, terracotta, grey) on a warm off-white matrix — exactly the multicolour-terrazzo look this slug represents. It is a hexagon product render on a white background, so the crop was taken strictly INSIDE the terrazzo field.
source.crop_reason: 330px square fully INSIDE the hexagon body — no hex edges, no white page background. Centred on the densest, most even confetti-chip distribution.
source.rejected_set: No other multicolour-white terrazzo in the curated террацо folder; the graphite/black variants belong to terrazzo-epoxy, and the cement-concrete macros are grey (terrazzo-cement / decorative-concrete).

material_truth.fillers: Multicolour aggregate confetti — crushed marble + recycled-glass + pigmented chips (~3-10 mm): cobalt/petrol blue, ochre/amber, terracotta, warm-grey and charcoal flecks. Fine quartz fill in the matrix.
material_truth.matrix: Warm off-white cement/resin matrix (near-white, slightly cream).
material_truth.finish: Ground + sealed, satin (not high-gloss). Smooth surface relief with shallow chip edges.
material_truth.manufacturer_recipe: Decorative terrazzo body (e.g. Sika Sikafloor Terrazzo CS-31 white-pigmented or epoxy-terrazzo Decodur EP-Terrazzo) with a custom multicolour glass/marble broadcast on a white matrix; lithium-silicate or PU satin seal.

colour.note: Near-white warm matrix dominates (stdev ~16). Matrix hex ≈ overall mean because chips are sparse against the white field. Markedly warmer/creamier than a pure #ffffff.

scale.physical_mm_per_tile: ~210-230 mm represented by the 2048px master (chips read ~3-10 mm at this crop; source tile is a 32x37 cm product and the 330px crop spans roughly the central ~22 cm).
scale.tile_note: Manifest 'tile' is an integer repeat across the plate. 4 keeps the confetti chips at a realistic small read on a ~600-900 mm plate and helps mask the small-source repeat. Do NOT drop to 1 (chips would look oversized and the repeat would be obvious).

gloss.note: Satin ground+sealed terrazzo. roughness.png mean 0.363 (chipsSmooth=true → bright chips read smoother, white matrix mid-rough). 0.38-0.42 reads as satin; lower if a glossier seal is wanted.

normal.png.strength: gen-pbr bump 6.5 (per-chip relief + matrix grain); R range 0-254

processing.decode: sips/sharp JPG -> extract 330px square inside hexagon -> lanczos3 upscale to 2048 (UPSCALED ~6.2x from a 330px crop).
processing.delight: sharp divide-by-heavy-blur (sigma scaled to ~112px) re-multiplied by per-channel means -> lighting-neutral albedo. Source was an evenly-lit product render, so only a mild flatten was needed.
processing.seamless: Half-offset (quadrant-swap) wrap so the centre seam moves to the borders, then feathered cross-fade heal across the central cross blending with a 180°-rotated copy of the offset (NOT a blur — a blur smear is visible on a near-white field). Validated by 2x2 tiling.
processing.pbr: scripts/gen-pbr-maps.js terrazzo-multi --root=3d-assets/textures-v4 (bump 6.5, baseRough 0.6, chipsSmooth true, ao 1.3).

caveats: UPSCALED ~6.2x from a 330px source crop to 2048px — fine matrix grain is soft at 1:1; acceptable at render/normal viewing distance but this is the softest of the four masters.
Because the usable source region is small, the 2x2 tile shows a faint small-scale repeat of the chip pattern (no hard seam line). Higher manifest tile (4) keeps it subtle.
An object/background crop-out was not needed (product render on white) — but the hexagon edges and white page were excluded by the inside-crop.
Matrix is warm off-white (#ebe9e3), not pure white — true to the curated product image.

recommended_manifest.palette_note: matrix warm-white, overall mean, blue chip, amber chip, terracotta chip, grey chip, charcoal fleck
recommended_manifest.note: Repoint pbr.* to textures-v4/terrazzo-multi/* to use this new set. (Orchestrator applies — do not edit manifest here.)
